units: USD as reported by OCHA FTS; no currency or price adjustment

source.publisher: OCHA Financial Tracking Service (FTS), distributed by HDX
source.title: Global - Requirements and Funding Data
source.publisherHashAlgorithm: Not specified in the resource metadata; not used as SHA-256

source.interpretation: This is the HDX bulk CSV. The contextual HAPI guide describes a narrower processed endpoint and is not the downloaded data endpoint.

modification: Charitology selected the 2025 records, preserved their source strings and added filters, provenance and derived exact-rational coverage. This draft interpretation is not endorsed by OCHA or its partners.
limitations: Reported humanitarian funding and published plan requirements, not all charitable giving or independently measured need.
Rows are country × source plan identifier × reference year; identifiers can repeat across countries with different amounts.
Plans and other source rows can overlap. No country, plan or worldwide funding total is calculated here.
A blank is not zero. Rows without a plan identifier are not relabeled as country totals.
The source-rounded percent is distinct from the exact ratio derived from the reported USD amounts.
Funding can exceed requirements or include signed adjustments. Coverage is not effectiveness, unmet need or a charity rating.
A fixed source snapshot can change upstream later. Its HTTP Date and publisher modification strings are retained separately.
